limits: File hashes identify uncommitted trial source; no human naturalness verdict. Ledger residuals include unread native reactions, losses, changing mass and finite-step integration. Raw contact values are uncorrected.

support.scope: Same live game code, B settings, legacy grip. Each actual state is prepared before removing only the floor collider. State transitions remain enabled. Removal is a causal diagnostic, not a production terrain feature or human success criterion.
support.limitation: Native upright/joint reactions, full contact work, damping loss and changing-mass flux remain unmeasured. Contact forces are RAW and receive no 6/7 correction. Residuals are not automatically engine errors.

gripFixtures.scope: Native two-body fixtures using actual Fighter.offHand with IK omitted. Zero gravity, no contacts, no other actuators. No human grip validation. Native delta K includes spring response and integration effects; instantaneous power is measured separately. Zero applied net torque does not mean zero finite-step angular-momentum residual: dt-halving convergence is checked.

boundary.included: Selected dynamic rigid bodies, sword and armor collider mass counted once per body; loose dynamic bodies included according to owner/body selection.
boundary.excluded: Fixed ground/walls and kinematic upright anchors, plus dynamic bodies outside the selection.
boundary.nativeUnmeasured: Impulse joint/motor/upright forces and work are not read. Contact impulses stay raw and are not used to close the residual; no 6/7 correction.
boundary.potentialDefinition: V=-sum(m*gravityScale*g dot (worldCOM-origin)); uniform gravity, geometric potential zero at origin.

mobileLocal.method: Actual portrait link tap, landscape Start tap, >3s live simulation, CDP touch drag and restart; AI update disabled to isolate input. No naturalness or hardware performance verdict.

protocol.duel: actual AI normal on both actors; longsword vs zweihander, 30 seconds, no park/injury injection or early death exit
protocol.getup: same force_default_trace hurt_getup: total8s, at3s player legF=.45 and knockDown(false); enemy parked, player has no AI
protocol.scope: Every frame finite state of all dynamic world bodies and world-transformed anatomical/sword-grip joint anchors; actual Combat wounds/clashes, live grip, fighter state changes. Contact manifolds sampled at10Hz as witnesses only. No human naturalness, balancing, or joint-gap acceptance threshold.
